verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 4 remains sound and complete. The lane parser selects the final completed dispatcher block, requires the fixed header and terminator, validates every contiguous row, rejects malformed, duplicate, over-cap, missing, and reordered required lanes as a whole, and permits future lanes without weakening the required-lane order. The parsed values and generator-owned display state are carried through the real history path and rendered with bounded, text-only DOM operations; missing data stays explicitly unknown. The tests exercise the parser, failure-return arity, publication seam, real page script, zero counts, hostile state values, required ordering, unknown-lane compatibility, and alert-state containment with independent literal expectations. I found no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue. With no findings in either round 3 or round 4, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
